faq.q: How much is pad rent on a Langley mobile home?
faq.a: The figure that matters is the specific park's current rent in its written Manufactured Home Site Tenancy Agreement — current rent, last increase date, and what the rent includes.

faq.q: How much can pad rent go up each year?
faq.a: 2.3% + proportional amount for 2026; 2.2% + proportional amount for 2027; once every 12 months on 3 full months' notice; the proportional amount is park-specific, so ask the park for its last calculation.

faq.q: Does the park raise my pad rent when I buy?
faq.a: No — on assignment under MHPTA s.28 the pad rent stays the same and the next increase date does not reset; assignment requires the landlord's prior written consent (or deemed consent, or an order of the director) and no consent fee may be charged.

faq.q: Do I own the land in a Langley park?
faq.a: In a pad-rental park, no: you own the home (a chattel) and rent the pad.
